transunion_acr.title: When your report has a lot of damage
transunion_acr.description: Late payments, collections, and charge-offs - see how we'd line up what to fix first. Sample only; your real report would be yours.

visitor_placeholders.strategy_round_summary: For this scenario we prioritize adverse tradelines and collections before inquiries - the same ordering rules members get on a busy file.
visitor_placeholders.strategy_rationale: Demo uses a deterministic slice of items; your file would be fully personalized after signup.

experian.title: When you need more than a basic 'please fix this'
experian.description: Some issues involve timing, proof, and what fair-credit rules say. This demo shows how we highlight that when the facts fit - not legal advice.

visitor_placeholders.strategy_round_summary: Where statutes and bureau duties apply, selection weights validation and timeline leverage - surfaced here as a capability preview only.
visitor_placeholders.strategy_rationale: Not legal advice; demo illustrates how the engine surfaces leverage-aware ordering when the data supports it.

equifax.title: When you're new to credit or don't have many accounts
equifax.description: Few accounts doesn't mean you can't fix mistakes - plus ideas to strengthen your profile over time. Sample story, not your file.

visitor_placeholders.strategy_round_summary: Thin files get a mix of dispute-ready items plus diversification and profile-building moves - reflected in priorities and gameplan tone.
visitor_placeholders.strategy_rationale: Demo highlights build-and-clean strategy; real output depends on your tradeline mix.
